facing: Blender -Y = glTF +Z: in Godot the model faces +Z (use look_at(target, Vector3.UP, true) or rotate 180 deg)
origin: ground level where the body emerges from the chasm; the torso continues ~5.5 m below ground (hide/clip below the chasm lip)

clips.name: rise
clips.notes: starts fully below ground (crown tip below 0), ends on idle frame 0

clips.name: slam_l
clips.notes: left hand slams; 1.2 s telegraph (arm raised high), impact at 1.33 s

clips.name: slam_r
clips.notes: right hand slams; 1.2 s telegraph (arm raised high), impact at 1.33 s

clips.name: sweep
clips.notes: beam from the 'beam' bone (maw), pointing along the bone (+Y of the bone = forward out of the mouth); head lowers and sweeps from its left to its right

clips.name: shard
clips.notes: right-arm flick; spawn the shard volley at the right hand ('hand.R') at release, thrown forward

clips.name: death
clips.notes: convulses, collapses backward and sinks fully below ground; last frame holds (hide the model after)

nodes.node_l: separate MeshInstance3D 'node_l', skinned 100% to bone 'bone_node_l' (left shoulder front)
nodes.node_r: separate MeshInstance3D 'node_r', skinned 100% to bone 'bone_node_r' (right shoulder front)
nodes.node_c: separate MeshInstance3D 'node_c', skinned 100% to bone 'bone_node_c' (centre chest)
nodes.bone_naming: bones are 'bone_node_*' so they do not collide with the mesh names (Godot renames colliding bones)
nodes.how_to_hide: set the MeshInstance3D .visible = false (they sit under the Skeleton3D); hit-test with spheres on the node bones (radius ~0.9 m l/r, ~1.05 m c)

sockets.beam: beam (maw; beam direction = bone axis, forward out of the mouth)
sockets.head: head

notes: All clips in place; the root never moves. rise starts fully underground, death ends fully underground.
Loop idle in code (Godot imports clips non-looping).
EmitMaw = glowing mouth core (pulse it for the beam charge); EmitNode = the three weak points.
